mapper.sql: select id, user_id, username, module, operation, description, request_method, request_url, request_ip, request_params, response_data, status, error_msg, execution_time, operation_time, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from audit_operation_log
mapper.insert: insert into audit_operation_log ( user_id, username, module, operation, description, request_method, request_url, request_ip, request_params, response_data, status, error_msg, execution_time, operation_time, remark, create_by, create_time )values( #{userId}, #{username}, #{module}, #{operation}, #{description}, #{requestMethod}, #{requestUrl}, #{requestIp}, #{requestParams}, #{responseData}, #{status}, #{errorMsg}, #{executionTime}, #{operationTime}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.delete:
delete from audit_operation_log where id in
#{id}
mapper.select: select module, operation, count(*) as count, sum(case when status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as success_count, sum(case when status = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as fail_count from audit_operation_log where user_id = #{userId} group by module, operation order by count desc

select date_format(operation_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as operation_date, count(*) as count, sum(case when status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as success_count, sum(case when status = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as fail_count from audit_operation_log where module = #{module} and operation_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day) group by date_format(operation_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by operation_date desc
mapper.delete: delete from audit_operation_log where operation_time < date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day)
